ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced KYC/AML screening of every UBO, proposed manager, and significant corporate counterparty against: (i) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, (ii) the UN Security Council sanctions lists (including ISIL/Al-Qaida), (iii) OFAC SDN/partially relevant lists where USD operations are anticipated, (iv) the French TRACFIN typology lists, and (v) national French criminal/confiscation records. PEP status must be checked using commercially available databases and corroborated by negative-news screening, with a mandatory French sworn-translation clearing step for non-French documentation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises operated by INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), with pre-availability verification through Infogreffe / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for RCS registration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate constitutional documents and registration formalities must be in French. The SARL name may include a foreign-language or internationally used element, but for RCS purposes the name must permit a clear Roman-script transliteration and be legally recordable under the French Informatique et Libertés rules. A statutory French translation of all non-French documents is mandatorily filed.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banking and monopoly financial terms: 'banque', 'assureur', 'caution', 'fiduciaire', 'société de financement', 'crédit'
Misleading residential or geographic terms: 'France' or 'Paris' where no distinct public entity status exists, and any term likely to create confusion with a public establishment
Terms of agricultural certification not held: 'engrais certifié', 'Bio/AB', 'éco-responsable' where third-party certification is absent, potentially triggering DGCCRF review
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a refusal notification from the Greffe or INPI Guichet Unique, the applicant may within 15 calendar days file a written administrative request for reconsideration with the Director of the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce. If the refusal is maintained, an appeal may be brought by requête before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce in the jurisdiction of the registered office. In parallel, the applicant may immediately file a new registration request with a modified and re-verified name. Any opposition based on third-party pre-existing rights is handled either before the civil court or through INPI trademark opposition proceedings.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Limited: Article L.123-36-2 of the French Commercial Code permits the use of a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) for the registered office, generally for up to five years. A pure virtual office with no local operational capability is not considered sufficient for a wholesale fertilizer/agrochemical business because customs authorities, DGCCRF and TRACFIN will expect a French operational address, accessible records, and responsible personnel. The registered office must also be suitable for receipt of official notices and statutory document preservation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium-high quantified risk: approximately 45% probability of an unannounced physical inspection within the first 18 months of operation, driven by French customs (DGDDI) control of fertilizer imports, DGCCRF market surveillance, and tax substance verification by the Direction Générale des Finances Publiques.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via official portal https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL obtains SIREN/SIRET from INSEE; VAT TIN assigned as FR followed by 11 digits upon registration. Foreign entities register for SIRET and VAT if establishing permanent establishment or exceeding turnover thresholds.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box elections; hybrid mismatch provisions under EU ATAD directive apply; micro-entreprise regime available only for qualifying small businesses.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory facturation électronique for B2B transactions; real-time VAT reporting via PEPIT platform; digital invoice stamping and clearance through French tax administration systems.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for goods exported outside the EU or intra-EU supplies where customer is VAT-registered and proof of dispatch to third country or another EU member state is provided.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims trigger full VAT liability, penalties up to 80% of evaded tax, interest charges, and potential criminal sanctions; retrospective clawback of benefits.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France — under the French Monetary and Financial Code, with external exchange-control oversight by Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury) and credit institution supervision by ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies full euro convertibility under Articles 63-66 TFEU; no capital-control authorization is required for ordinary current or capital account flows. Capital account transactions are subject to statistical and prudential reporting to Banque de France, and dividend or branch-revenue remittances are free but must comply with French corporate formalities and any applicable withholding/anti-abuse rules.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds. French resident companies may receive and retain foreign currency in authorized accounts; however, the exporter must file the required balance-of-payments declarations (OFI declarations) to Banque de France and maintain documentary evidence of the underlying transaction for at least five years.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-medium. Authorized EU EMIs may support euro collection and some settlement, but offshore digital EMIs cannot open a domestic bank account for a French SARL and typically cannot issue trade finance instruments such as commercial standby letters of credit or export/import documentary credits. An EMI can only serve as a secondary operational rail, never as the principal clearing account for commodity transactions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical or in-person KYC interview is generally mandatory for ultimate beneficial owners and signing directors, particularly for non-resident shareholders or complex chains, though French AML law permits qualified remote onboarding via trusted video identification and digital signatures. In practice, French tier-1 banks require at least one face-to-face meeting or a notarized certified identification at the time of account opening and before activating high-value cross-border payments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex beneficial-ownership hierarchy with non-EU parent
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full organizational chart, French RBE (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) filing, certified passports/power-of-attorney, shareholder register excerpt, and notarized corporate formation documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commodity-trader profile with high-volume urea/potash import-export flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Audited financial statements, multi-party commercial purchase/sales contracts, official invoices, packing lists, cargo/shipping bill of lading, insurance certificates, and transfer pricing or tax files demonstrating genuine economic substance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Materials with perceived chemical or dual-use sensitivity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Technical safety data sheets, end-use declarations from final buyers, no-clearing certificates issued by the French Ministry of Economy when applicable, and sourcing evidence that fertilizer-grade urea and potassium chloride are agricultural commodity products not subject to export-control embargoes.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injection should be executed by SWIFT MT103 from the foreign parent to the SARL's designated euro-denominated operational account at a French bank. The payment purpose should reference the Bank of France OFI transaction code applicable to direct investment equity inflows and include the words 'augmentation de capital' / capital increase, accompanied by a certified board resolution, updated corporate articles, and the Bank of France foreign-transaction declaration where the aggregate flow triggers reporting thresholds. The bank must verify account-name restrictions and economic-beneficiary rules before crediting funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound settlement for fertilizer purchases should be routed through SWIFT MT103 for open-account disbursements or through documentary letters of credit issued under UCP600 (MT700/MT710 with MT103 remittance) for secured trade payments. Euro-denominated intra-EU settlements may clear via TARGET2 or SEPA, while non-EUR transactions use correspondent banking networks (CHIPS/CHAPS/Fedwire), with full SWIFT gpi tracking and payment purpose codes aligned to French customs and VAT declarations.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards documented under the French Master FX Agreement or ISDA
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) solely for currencies subject to convertibility restrictions in the target market
Rolling spot and pre-hedge strategies executed through an authorized French credit institution

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced rate of 15% for the first EUR 42,000 of taxable profit of eligible SMEs (paid-up capital fully liberated and turnover < EUR 10 million, Art. 219-I-b CGI). No social solidarity surcharge below EUR 7.63 million turnover; above that threshold a 3.3% contribution is levied on the amount of corporate income tax exceeding EUR 763,000, bringing the effective marginal statutory burden to approx. 25.83%. Incentives relevant to fertiliser wholesale: R&D credit (credit d'impôt recherche, 30%), innovation credit (20%), patronage/that's
